required_action: If status is skipped, skip dependent REGENIE analyses. Where permitted run python tools/literature/install_regenie.py --allow-download (Windows additionally --allow-source-build --cygwin-root C:/cygwin64). For missing Cygwin prerequisites supply an existing toolchain with gcc-g++, gcc-fortran, make, Python 3.8-3.10 and zlib-devel, or use a permitted supported Linux/macOS host. Preserve existing/corrupt runtimes and choose a new destination. After installation run scientific/project fixtures; version alone is not validation.
scope: Existing Cygwin toolchain read-only; source and native libraries copied privately, no global PATH/OS package changes. Official upstream supports Linux/macOS and recommends WSL on Windows. This Cygwin source profile is locally tested for the documented subset only; compiler warnings/failed research attempts remain retained.
